contract.note: The comparative reading is ordinary and avoids inventing an absolute threshold. Using the latest completed annual period is a reasonable reporting convention. The possible climate benefit is properly excluded from scoring.

The report establishes substantial generative-AI private investment, but supplies no matching specialized-AI category or complete funding comparison.
Substantial climate-AI investment challenges an absolute no-large-funding reading. Category overlap and unmatched coverage prevent resolution of the comparative claim.

reviews.rationale: Neither firm comparison is settled. Investment categories do not match the speaker's distinction, and per-task emissions do not establish aggregate harm. The substantial climate-AI funding is material context but does not supply a comparable industry-wide split.
